data.name: Haaziq
data.gender_notes: Haaziq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-z-q' which means 'to ask, seek, or question'. Haaziq is a name for those who are constantly in search of knowledge and wisdom. The name Haaziq carries the meaning “Seeker, Questioner” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haaziq usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker, questioner and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those seeking knowledge and wisdom in the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Haaziq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker, Questioner.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haaziq total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
